name: maintenance
description: A Chip Kitchen run into the ground and then rescued. Hand-farms four rows of potatoes, buys the kitchen, and feeds it batch after batch until wear drops it below the effect threshold — at which point it runs at half speed, jams every tenth operation, and spoils an input on a fixed cadence. Every one of those is a consequence of work done, never a roll. Ends with one $8 repair kit bought at the bin and spent on the cell, restoring the machine to full in a single use.
